questions.q: Which approach best summarizes safe HMM paramedic practice during Hajj?

options: Treat every patient without considering urgency
Prioritize safe patient care, infection control, documentation, communication and timely referral

questions.q: After a seizure, an unconscious but breathing person should generally be?

options: Placed safely on their side while breathing is monitored

options: Patient information should be accessed and disclosed only by authorized persons for legitimate purposes
Patient information should be publicly posted

options: To provide immediate basic management of injuries and emergencies

options: Recognize the limitation and use appropriate rest/support arrangements

options: Protect the person from injury and clear nearby hazards
Put a spoon in the person's mouth

questions.q: A conscious person with suspected low blood sugar who can swallow safely may be given?
questions.urdu: اگر کسی ہوش مند شخص میں خون میں شوگر کی کمی کا شبہ ہو اور وہ محفوظ طریقے سے نگل سکتا ہو، تو اسے کیا دیا جا سکتا ہے؟

options: Arrange appropriate referral/transfer to the required healthcare facility

questions.q: A pilgrim becomes separated from his group. The paramedic should?

options: Immobilizing the injured area and arranging medical assessment

options: Tell the pilgrim to stop worrying
Promise that there is no serious problem
Listen carefully, communicate calmly, and provide appropriate reassurance

options: Place the person in the recovery position and monitor breathing

Only that another staff member has previously used the medicine
